entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange operated by FAMEEX INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD, providing spot markets, perpetual futures, account-based trading, and other exchange products for global users.
entity.notes: First-party About and registration/help pages identify FAMEEX INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD as the FameEX operator and state that the company has been registered in Australia since 2020. Current first-party announcements remain active through 2026-08-26. HEI keeps launch_date null because the reviewed material supports 2020 only, not an exact launch day. AUSTRAC/DCE registration is retained only as operating-entity context and is not interpreted as a safety endorsement. HEI consolidates FameEX spot and derivatives discovery rows under one exchange entity.
